details: Closed has exact order exists epsilon0>0, for all small positive epsilon, exists threshold K, for all F and CH; K is independent of the eventual chosen family and height constant.
TransportedAlt.sup takes pointwise maxima. FamP.large_sup is an equivalence, so a single joined threshold works for every condition, including thresholds depending on earlier parameter lists.
DesignExists takes every threshold K before supplying F and CH. The design range is intersected with the finitely many closure ranges first. No choice of unrelated family witnesses is combined.
The empty conjunction is harmless because the source threshold type is inhabited. The design class is transported through the stated class inclusions before applying the closed conditions.

The table has exactly nine closed conditions apart from DesignExists: LinkN, LinkDIVt, LinkEta, LinkIRR, SmallLevelRankEq, fullness/rank, LinkG, LinkS and LinkGLOBAL. Conditional TuSize/DGamSize/ChosenE dependencies are retained.

VVle quantifies over every algebraic closure and local-data system; instantiate it at the original D.nd.Om and D.nd.ldat. Finiteness plus NData.sha_eq identifies the actual stored rational lengths with natural finite cohomological lengths.

vvTerm is nonnegative and vanishes on nonprimes. The finite-subsum bound implies summability and total sum at most sqrt(b). b>=1 gives sqrt(b)<=b. This supplies ShaFinOdd and the summability antecedent of LinkN_at on the same D.

For every used lift j, its interval membership gives m>=1; the rank/frame supplies f>=1. At late scales x>1 and epsilon>0 give y=x^epsilon>=1. B0=f*m*b*y, Nc>=0, and log(x)^2<=y give A=f*m*b*y^2+log(x)^2*Nc<=y*(B0+Nc), with A nonnegative.

There is no sign assumption on C: C*A<=abs(C)*A. Also V<=b<=B0<=y*(B0+Nc). Multiplication by nonnegative D0 proves precisely eta_j<=D0*(abs(C)+1)*y*(B0+Nc), with one constant independent of all scale indices and lifts.
Only finitely many eventual bounds are intersected; each was already universal in the moving family indices. The maximum threshold does not require those index sets to be finite.
LinkEta and DIVinN feed the actual LinkDIVt. TuSize and DGamSize supply MuTu and MuDGam, while the chosen same-family fullness/rank fields supply the other antecedents of DA.6.

The metric arrow is retained, not inferred from rank counts. In source it uses ZeroAbove, finite generation, positive rank, actual nprimeDef, stored good metrics, and actual size estimates through nprimeMuR_at. These are not replaced by data from isomorphic but unrelated spaces.

GlobalTheoremInputs has precisely LinkG, LinkS, LinkIRR, LinkDIV and LinkMu. LinkGLOBAL plus ChosenE produces the final constants before the moving x. eD and eL are fixed before epsilon, as required by FamilyClassConnected and the analytic window limit.
GChi has the same-host EAtH and VVle clauses, and its class includes the window condition. The audit treats HostExW and the actual same-family design/link suppliers as open sufficient premises.
HP1–HP4 are distinguished from their geometric application. HP5–HP6 retain the exact field/frame/row premises; a representation theorem does not supply full Core.
The new window and cohomological assemblies are described as conditional interfaces, not as existence of their arithmetic suppliers.
The real-stage alternative is presented as an OR gate only when the actual large-gap rows are covered; other Core fields remain required.
Classical named theorem leaves require exact statement matching. Historic claim counts and empty dependency arrays are explicitly not used as a completion certificate.

scope_limit: Independent mathematical and targeted source-interface review of DA1–DA2 and audit scope; not an exhaustive source dependency graph, Lean kernel replay, proof of the retained metric comparison, or proof of the arithmetic suppliers.
